description: This file manages device power states and deep sleep procedures for the MEC172x microcontroller, including saving and restoring hardware states, configuring peripherals, and handling deep sleep wake-up features.

methods.name: soc_debug_sleep_clk_req
methods.description: Debug function to save sleep clock request status for MEC172x.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_non_wake_en
methods.description: Enables peripherals to wake the PLL without waking the EC.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_non_wake_dis
methods.description: Disables peripherals from waking the PLL.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_wake_en
methods.description: Enables wake sources for deep sleep, such as KSCAN and PS2.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_wake_dis
methods.description: Disables wake sources for deep sleep.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_periph_save
methods.description: Saves hardware state before entering deep sleep.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_periph_restore
methods.description: Restores hardware state after waking from deep sleep.
